title: Fixed Part Unfolded Pullout Sofa Bed
description: One original complete sofa with its own partly unfolded pullout bed carrier. A low upholstered back shell, two complete arms, rear underframe, anchor blocks and four feet surround the rear section of one continuous three-frame folding assembly. Two whole rectangular bed frames lie out in front on two complete grounded U supports, while the third whole foot frame remains angled upward about its real end-to-end hinge pins. Three separate thick mattress sections rest on their respective complete open frames and cross supports; rear carrier links join the assembly to the sofa anchors. No imported sofa or separate bed is placed as a scene. This low internally folding carrier differs from the ordinary fixed two-seat sofa and tall cabinet wall-bed with one full pivoting mattress. Three constant opaque PBR materials, metres Z up, true XY envelope centred, grounded soles, one complete prop and zero scenes. Fixed partly unfolded appearance only; no sleeping surface usability, full folding clearance, pullout travel, upholstery simulation, comfort, load, balance, installation or safety claim.
